verdict.rationale: No documented export mechanism appears in the pack. The only support for leaving is indirect: community reports of teams migrating from Elasticsearch to OpenSearch (elastic-comm-3, elastic-comm-4), self-managed and deploy-anywhere options (elastic-docs-13, elastic-docs-45), and a user noting the license still allows self-hosting if the vendor folds (elastic-comm-8). missing for 10: documented bulk/full data export tooling, explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV/Parquet), export from Elastic Cloud Serverless, and hands-on corroboration of a complete export-and-leave workflow.
